old: A direction arriving at one released control leaves rest of that surface to express. Bi-momentarying, co-competencing and co-intelligencing carry discovering at whole surface, with bettering, fastering and cheapering at its continuing service.

why: at: with, across; released control, a fixed form that leaves: dissolved; 'with ... at its continuing service': bettering, fastering and cheapering its continuing service, by meaning.

why: doer, a file carrying: re-said as the concepts going together, with Natural Values.

old: **Co-releasing** is each side releasing its own, neither releasing an other.
new: **Co-releasing** is each side going on with its own, neither going on with an other's.
why: Co-releasing stays as a naming awaiting one motion, and this sentence defines its motion as releasing. Nothing is held or released, so the definition needs a motion; choosing one would settle what the naming still awaits. My re-saying takes going on, each side's own completing continuing, neither side completing for an other. To resolve: is co-releasing's motion each side going on with its own, or another motion?

old: A turn taken at one side leaves an other's taking its own. Natural Naming carries these relations at bi-coupling, co-releasing, floating neutral and bi-momentarying.
new: A turn taken by one side leaves an other's taking its own. These relations are Natural Naming's bi-coupling, co-releasing, floating neutral and bi-momentarying.
why: at: by; doer, a file carrying, with at: re-said as the relations themselves, Natural Naming's.

old: A coding language is of gates and one-way directing: *if* passes one side, *for* steps through a sequence, *return* directs one way out. At a built substrate method is at its form as it is at a protein, a fold gating and coupling at an active site. Resolver has no clock: a place in a sequence, and no time. Building makes no natural technology; it makes substrates method is at.
new: A coding language is of gates and one-way directing: *if* passes one side, *for* steps through a sequence, *return* directs one way, back to its calling. With a built substrate, method is with its form as it is with a protein, a fold gating and coupling with an active site. Resolver has no clock: a place within a sequence, and no time. Building makes no natural technology; it makes substrates, and method is with them.
why: out: back to its calling, by meaning; at: with; in a sequence: within a sequence, a whole and its part. *if*, *for*, *return* are words mentioned, kept.
